prevention: Large image bundles remain on D:. Additional load images are pulled by one scheduled node at a time; multi-node sequential imports are not repeated.
recovery: The interrupted import was terminated, docker-desktop WSL was terminated, stale Docker Desktop processes were stopped, and Docker Desktop was restarted.
scientific_handling: No measurements from the interrupted pilot are accepted. CoreDNS and all Online Boutique deployments were rolled cleanly before a new pilot baseline.
trigger: Sequential containerd image imports filled the Windows host file cache, reducing available host RAM to approximately 0.58 GiB and hanging Docker.
